species.name: rồng
species.note: a lineage rather than a body: what makes a skill about being a dragon carryable by more than one character

species.name: thằn lằn
species.note: the body, which is what a creature can be at the same time as being a dragon

species.name: thực vật
species.note: something that grows, which is what roots and photosynthesis read as; the two skills that mean it are restricted to it, and the blighter preset gave them up rather than model a body as a fighting style

species.name: rùa
species.note: a shell, which withdraw was named after before it was reworded as a stance

species.name: con người
species.note: Không vảy, không mai, không cánh — cái gì cũng phải học mới có
